items.stem: Plan A for a mobile data pack costs ₹20 plus ₹4 per GB; Plan B costs ₹320 plus ₹3 per GB. Write the cost of each plan for g GB as a linear rule, find for how many GB both plans cost the same, and say which plan is cheaper for heavy users.

items.stem: A small shop has 7 people. Their monthly incomes are: ₹15,000, ₹16,000, ₹17,000, ₹19,000, ₹21,000, ₹23,000, ₹2,40,000 (the last is the owner). items.stem: Explain why the angle in a semicircle is 90°.
